audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is nonce incremented before message execution?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL transaction processing (nonce increment, process_message_call) not implemented in Prysm CL client. Functions increment_nonce and process_transaction do not exist in this codebase.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are gas fees deducted from sender balance before message execution?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL gas fee deduction (effective_gas_fee, blob_gas_fee, process_message_call) not implemented in Prysm CL client. No EVM transaction execution exists in this codebase.

audit_items.title: Is unused gas refunded at the correct effective_gas_price?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL gas refund calculation (gas_left * effective_gas_price) not implemented in Prysm CL client. No EVM gas accounting exists in this codebase.

audit_items.title: Does coinbase receive only the priority fee portion (not base fee)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL coinbase payment and EIP-1559 fee distribution (priority fee vs base fee) not implemented in Prysm CL client. No EVM fee accounting exists in this codebase.

audit_items.title: Are accounts marked for deletion destroyed after transaction execution?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL account deletion via SELFDESTRUCT (accounts_to_delete set processing) not implemented in Prysm CL client. No EVM state management exists in this codebase.

audit_items.title: Does beacon roots system transaction execute before user transactions?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL system transaction ordering (apply_body, process_unchecked_system_transaction for BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not execute EL system transactions or control their ordering.

audit_items.title: Does history storage system transaction execute as second operation?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL system transaction ordering (apply_body, process_unchecked_system_transaction for HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not execute EL system transactions.

audit_items.title: Are transactions processed in sequential order within a block?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL transaction ordering within block execution (apply_body sequential processing) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not process EL transactions.

audit_items.title: Are withdrawals processed after all transactions?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL withdrawal ordering within apply_body (after transaction execution) is an EL execution concern. Prysm's ProcessWithdrawals is CL-side beacon state withdrawal processing, not EL block body execution ordering.

audit_items.title: Are general purpose requests processed last in block body?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL general purpose request ordering (process_general_purpose_requests in apply_body) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not control EL block body execution ordering.

audit_items.title: Are request types appended in correct order (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL request type ordering within process_general_purpose_requests (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not assemble EL request lists.

audit_items.title: Are deposit requests parsed from block output logs (not system transactions)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL deposit request parsing from log entries (parse_deposit_requests) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client receives processed deposits from EL via Engine API, it does not parse EL logs.

audit_items.title: Are withdrawal and consolidation requests from checked system transactions?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL system transaction type (checked vs unchecked) for withdrawal and consolidation request contracts is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not execute EL system transactions.

audit_items.title: Are blocks with number < 1 rejected?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL block number validation in validate_header is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client validates beacon blocks (slots), not EL block numbers in header validation.

audit_items.title: Are block timestamps strictly increasing?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL block timestamp validation in validate_header is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not perform EL-style header timestamp validation.

audit_items.title: Are block numbers sequential (parent.number + 1)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL block number sequentiality validation in validate_header is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client validates beacon chain slots, not EL block number sequences.

audit_items.title: Does parent_hash cryptographically match parent header?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL parent_hash cryptographic verification in validate_header (keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header))) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not perform EL header hash verification.

audit_items.title: Does excess_blob_gas match calculation from parent?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL excess_blob_gas calculation and validation in validate_header is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL stores ExcessBlobGas as a passthrough field from EL payload but does not validate the calculation.

audit_items.title: Is gas_used <= gas_limit enforced in header?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL gas_used <= gas_limit header validation is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not validate EL gas accounting invariants.

audit_items.title: Do system transactions originate from SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xff...fe)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL system transaction origin address (SYSTEM_ADDRESS) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not construct or validate EL system transactions.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does base fee calculation enforce minimum increase of 1 when gas exceeds target?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL base fee calculation (calculate_base_fee_per_gas) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not implement EIP-1559 base fee calculations.

audit_items.title: Verify transaction validation check ordering: Are checks ordered from general to specific?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL transaction validation dispatch ordering (type -> fees -> gas limits -> blob-specific -> authorization) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not validate EL transactions.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is extra_data in block header limited to 32 bytes?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL extra_data header length validation in validate_header is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not validate EL header field sizes.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is gas limit change bounded by parent_gas_limit // 1024?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL gas limit change validation (check_gas_limit, parent_gas_limit // 1024 bound) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not validate EL gas limit adjustments.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is gas limit >= 5000 (GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM) enforced?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL minimum gas limit validation (GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM = 5000 in check_gas_limit) is an EL execution concern. Prysm CL client does not validate EL gas limit minimums.
